title: Intermittent connection loss with Dexcom G6
symptom: The connection between xDrip on a Soyes 7S phone and a Dexcom G6 drops intermittently, showing Signal Missed until Bluetooth is manually toggled or the phone is rebooted.
evidence_quote: I decided to return the phone as the Bluetooth connection seemed to disconnect intermittently and the 3G data didn't work.
